annotations.title: Can a Japan taxpayer claim a relative living abroad as a dependent, and how much does it save?

description: Applies Japan's income tax rules for non-resident relatives (国外居住親族, Income Tax Act art. 84/85 and 2023 + 2026 revisions; rules as of 2026-10-25, NTA Q&A revised 2026-08). Ages 16-29 and 70+ qualify on relationship + remittance proof; ages 30-69 only if studying abroad, disabled, or you sent ¥380,000+ to them in the year (送金関係書類 / 38万円送金書類). Relative income limit ¥620,000 for 2026 (¥580,000 for 2025). Amounts: general ¥380,000, specified 19-22 ¥630,000 (special deduction table above the limit), elderly 70+ ¥480,000, spouse ¥380,000/480,000 by taxpayer income, disability add-on ¥270,000/¥400,000; under 16 no dependent deduction. Valid proof: bank transfer, credit card family card, electronic payment; cash and payments via a third party don't count; 3+ payments allow a statement with first and last records. Returns verdict (eligible | conditional | short_of_380k | not_eligible), route, deductions[], totalDeduction, estimatedIncomeTaxSaving (incl. 2.1% surtax), remittance {minimumTotal, shortfall, sendBy, statementOption}, documents, forms, steps, warnings, NTA sources, disclaimer. Use for 'can I claim my parents abroad', 年末調整 国外扶養, sending money home. Educational, not tax advice; not affiliated with the NTA.

age.description: Relative's age on Dec 31 of the tax year. Give age or birthDate.

birthDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD (born Jan 1 counts a year older).

disability.description: Disability under Japanese criteria. Default none.

firstLastTotal.description: Sum of the first and last payments of the year.

marginalRate.description: Your income-tax bracket in percent (5, 10, 20, 23, 33, 40, 45) to estimate the saving.

method.description: How you paid. Default bank. cash / via_representative / joint_account are not valid proof.

relationship.description: Relationship to the taxpayer. parent includes parent-in-law; other = other relative within 6 degrees of blood / 3 of marriage.

relativeIncome.description: Relative's total income (合計所得金額) in yen; usually 0 for a non-resident with no Japan-source income.

remittanceCount.description: Number of payments (3+ unlocks the statement option).

remittanceTotal.description: Yen paid directly to this relative in the year. Omit if unknown → verdict conditional.

studyingAbroad.description: Relative left Japan to study abroad (ages 30-69 route).

taxpayerIncome.description: Your own total income in yen (spouse amounts depend on it).
